spec:
Remove the shipped historical-default blob archive at plugins/zzzops/zzzops/templates/history and simplify its dependent machinery coherently. Owner authorization, verbatim: "Yeah I think we can get rid of that tbh, barely anybody uses zzzops anyway". This explicitly authorizes retiring the barely-used history-backed upgrade compatibility, not merely deleting files and leaving broken consumers. Scope is template history only; unrelated active repository policy/workflow and old conversion/migration evidence remain out of scope.

Current dev 4bc7b4deba5f1a98595ab795cdb5c088c14b3c66 has 71 archived blobs (192,594 bytes). engine/defaults.py uses history_ids, inferred records and known-base classification to generate old/new diffs and three-way merge-file commands. Bootstrap update instructions, references/MIGRATING.md, .agents/template_history.py, archive/seed tests and contract docs assume the archive. Packaging currently enumerates shipped files, so verify generated/installable artifacts after removal.

Choose the smallest coherent simplification: remove the archive, updater/seed support and obsolete historical-base/inference/three-way upgrade behavior. Preserve current templates/default for bootstrap. Retain simple current-default hash provenance/last-reviewed-or-declined receipts if useful, avoiding a new store/schema unless necessary. Existing opaque schema1 TEMPLATE hashes must not all become misleading 'unknown newer engine, upgrade plugin' cases after history disappears. Keep a clear current-default versus local two-way comparison and explicit manual review. Preserve repository-owned customizations, locally added/deleted files and workflow/prompt coordination: no silent overwrite or deletion and no automatic fallback to shipped policy. Read-only next/validate/previews must not mutate local policy or TEMPLATE provenance. Adoption/decline remains an explicit reviewed policy procedure; this goal does not open a policy branch or rewrite installed policy.

Update bootstrap/default-update guidance, relevant references and SPEC/DESIGN/HISTORY so no live instructions point to removed files or promise unsupported old-base reconstruction/three-way merges. Preserve historical amendment records as history, with clear supersession rather than unrelated cleanup. Inspect SPEC capability/version rules and update capability/contract documentation if actually required; never weaken/remove compatibility-floor requirements just to pass checks. User compatibility simplification is authorized, so no repeated owner question about retaining archive machinery.

Use a short concrete design and required independent reviews. Replace or remove tests for unsupported archive/seed/three-way behavior; preserve meaningful customization-safety/advisory/read-only/current-comparison tests, including paths/quoting, missing/invalid records, current-hash review/decline and nonblocking notices. Fast local reproduction/focused real CLI/bare-Git checks first, then configured required local verification, package/generated-artifact checks and exact-head CI. No new infrastructure, generic redesign, unrelated migration removal or extra product behavior.

Use managed goal worktree; primary old detached checkout/untracked AGENTS stays untouched. Existing explicit 'Use admin merge' authorization applies only after exact current head and required checks are verified. Complete a concrete dev PR and normal goal integration/receipt; preserve all validation. Release/main/paperpin are paused: main b029 has an externally inconsistent GitHub merge receipt and no publication. Do not claim a release or fabricate a release pin. G1046 is held pending actual publication. Other backlog goals remain release 2; this cleanup is release 1/P1. Never consume banked usage reset.
title: Remove template history and simplify safe default updates
